title: Midnight Caprice
subtitle: 1974 Chevrolet Caprice Classic Convertible
summary: Twin-turbo LS3 408 stroker, chassis-integrated roll cage, bagged Pro-Touring suspension, 35-spline Ford 9-inch, and Morimoto bi-LEDs.

specifications.lighting: Morimoto Bi-LED & Continuous Red COB Taillights

narrative: Midnight Caprice transforms a full-size 1974 Caprice Classic convertible into a low-slung, twin-turbocharged Pro-Touring cruiser.
Built with a custom chassis-integrated roll cage, bagged air-ride suspension, and a 35-spline Ford 9-inch rear axle to handle modern high-boost output.
Aesthetic highlights include modern Morimoto bi-LED headlamps, seamless continuous red COB LED taillights, and custom script emblems.

subtitle: 1948 Studebaker Champion 4-Door Deluxe
summary: Grand Touring concept featuring a Papa Legba vèvè pinstripe on the hood nose and three pure .999 silver fractional coins embedded in the dash.
narrative: Project VôôDôô Chīle is a Grand Touring custom concept crafted around the classic body lines of a 1948 Studebaker Champion 4-door Deluxe.

The design incorporates subtle spiritual motifs, including a custom Papa Legba vèvè pinstripe flowing down the hood nose and three pure .999 silver fractional coins embedded flush into the dashboard timber.

title: HuDuGooRoo
subtitle: 1960 Chrysler Saratoga 2-Door Wagon
summary: Swamp Bronze finish, 6.2L supercharged Gen III Hemi, 8-speed auto with re-purposed dashboard pushbuttons, bagged stance on 20-inch wheels.
narrative: HuDuGooRoo is a custom road-touring wagon concept based on a rare 1960 Chrysler Saratoga 2-door wagon shell.
Finished in a distinct Swamp Bronze coat, it packs modern supercharged firepower with a 6.2L Gen III Hemi paired to an 8-speed automatic.
The modern 8-speed transmission is wired to operate via the factory dashboard pushbutton selector, riding on bagged air suspension and low-profile tires wrapped around 20-inch custom wheels.

title: Night Wraith
subtitle: 1965 Cadillac Convertible
summary: Gloss black low-slung convertible, boosted LS engine, multi-speed auto, narrow rear suicide doors, and ghosted pinstriping.

specifications.paint: Deep Gloss Black w/ Ghosted Pinstriping

narrative: Night Wraith presents a low-slung, pillarless 1965 Cadillac Convertible coated in deep gloss black paint with ghosted pinstriping.
Mechanical features include a boosted LS V8 engine, multi-speed transmission, bagged stance, and custom-engineered narrow rear suicide doors.

title: Reiver, The Corner Thief
subtitle: AWD Silhouette Race Car
summary: 1962/63 Mini 850 steel shell on a 4130 chromoly tube frame, MTB2 subframe, Honda B-series LS-VTEC, CR-V AWD transaxle, Haltech Elite 1500, and Scottish Saltire roof.

specifications.chassis: Custom 4130 Chromoly Rectangular Tube Space Frame

narrative: Reiver, The Corner Thief is an all-wheel-drive silhouette race car engineering design that drops a 1962/1963 Morris Mini 850 steel shell over a 4130 chromoly tube space frame.
Utilizes a Super Fast Minis MTB2 subframe housing a Honda B-series LS-VTEC engine managed by a Haltech Elite 1500 ECU, sending power through a CR-V AWD manual transaxle.
The chassis incorporates a uniform 12-inch outer diameter / 8-inch inner diameter diagonal prop-shaft tunnel base, 12-inch wheels on 165/60R12 tires, and a hand-painted Scottish Saltire roof graphic.

title: 1972 Nissan 240Z S30
subtitle: Chrysanthemum & Wave Stance Study
summary: Jet black front with platinum Chrysanthemum line art fading via micro-Seigaiha waves to smoke gray, toxic blood-orange cage/calipers, and 17-inch wheels.

specifications.livery: High-Gloss Jet Black into Smoke Gray w/ Platinum Chrysanthemum Line Art

narrative: A custom 1972 Nissan 240Z S30 restomod design featuring a high-gloss jet black nose that transitions into smoke gray at the rear via a traditional micro-Seigaiha wave pattern.
Adorned with platinum metallic Imperial Chrysanthemum line art, contrasting against a toxic blood-orange interior roll cage and brake calipers, welded sheet metal fender flares, and 17-inch wheels.

title: Twin-Turbo Fireball 320
summary: 700 HP E85 straight-eight engine packaging solution wrapped in a stretched 1939 Buick Business Coupe touring supercar chassis.
